Bronx County Family Court: Understanding the Family Court System

Address:
900 Sheridan Ave, Bronx, NY 10451, United States

Google Maps:
900 Sheridan Ave, Bronx, NY 10451

Operating Hours:

  • Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Saturday & Sunday: Closed

Contact Information:

  • Phone: (718) 618-2098
  • Fax: (718) 618-7875
  • Website: Bronx Family Court

Bronx County Family Court is a branch of the New York State Unified Court System that is responsible for handling a wide range of legal matters related to families and children. This includes divorce and separation cases, child custody and support cases, domestic violence cases, and adoption cases. The family court system is an important aspect of the legal system, as it provides a forum for individuals to resolve disputes and make decisions that will affect their lives and the lives of their families.

History of Bronx County Family Court

Bronx County Family Court has a long and rich history, dating back to the early days of the New York State court system. Over the years, the court has evolved and adapted to meet the changing needs of families and children, and today it is recognized as one of the most innovative and effective family courts in the country. Some of the key milestones in the history of Bronx County Family Court include the creation of specialized court programs, the adoption of new technologies, and the development of alternative dispute resolution programs.

Services Offered by Bronx County Family Court

Bronx County Family Court offers a wide range of services to families and children, including divorce and separation cases, child custody and support cases, domestic violence cases, and adoption cases. In divorce and separation cases, the court can help parties resolve disputes related to property division, alimony, and child custody and support. In child custody and support cases, the court can determine who will have physical custody of a child, as well as the amount of child support that will be paid. In domestic violence cases, the court can issue orders of protection to keep victims safe and hold perpetrators accountable. And in adoption cases, the court can help families navigate the legal process of adopting a child.

The Court Process

The court process in Bronx County Family Court typically begins with the filing of a case by one of the parties involved. This can be done by visiting the court in person or by filing the necessary paperwork online. Once a case has been filed, the court will schedule a pre-trial conference to discuss the issues involved and determine what steps need to be taken next. In some cases, the court may also schedule a mediation session to help the parties resolve their disputes without going to trial.

If the case cannot be resolved through mediation, it will proceed to trial. During the trial, each side will have the opportunity to present evidence and arguments, and the judge will make a decision based on the facts of the case. After the trial, the judge will issue a written decision that outlines the terms of the court's ruling.

How to Prepare for a Court Appearance

If you are appearing in Bronx County Family Court, it is important to be prepared. This includes gathering all of the relevant documents, hiring an attorney if necessary, and understanding the court rules and procedures. It is also important to be familiar with the issues involved in your case and to be able to articulate your position clearly and effectively.

Mediation and Alternative Dispute Resolution

Mediation is a form of alternative dispute resolution that can be used to resolve disputes in Bronx County Family Court. During a mediation session, a neutral third-party mediator will facilitate a discussion between the parties in an effort to help them reach a resolution. Mediation can be an effective way to resolve disputes, as it allows the parties to have a voice in the outcome and can help them to reach a mutually acceptable agreement.

Representing Yourself in Court

While it is always best to have an attorney represent you in court, some individuals choose to represent themselves. If you decide to represent yourself, it is important to be familiar with the court rules and procedures, and to be prepared to present your case effectively. There are resources available to help self-represented litigants, including legal aid organizations and online resources.

Resources and Support

In addition to the services offered by Bronx County Family Court, there are a number of resources and support services available to families and children. These include legal aid organizations, support groups, and counseling and therapy services. These resources can help families and children navigate the legal system and provide support during what can be a difficult time.

The Judges of Bronx County Family Court

The judges of Bronx County Family Court are highly qualified and experienced individuals who are responsible for making decisions that will affect the lives of families and children. Judges are appointed or elected based on their qualifications and experience, and they play a critical role in ensuring that the court system is fair and impartial.

The Future of Bronx County Family Court

As technology continues to advance, it is likely that the family court system will continue to evolve and adapt to meet the changing needs of families and children. Reforms and initiatives aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the court system will also play a role in shaping its future. Despite these changes, the fundamental role of the family court system in providing a forum for resolving disputes and making decisions that will affect families and children will remain unchanged.


Bronx Family Court Phone Number and Help Center

Bronx County Family Court can be reached by phone at (718) 618-3100. If you have a question or concern about your case, you can also visit the court's help center, located at 900 Sheridan Avenue in the Bronx. The help center is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and provides assistance to individuals who are navigating the court system.

Bronx Family Court Child Support

Child support is an important issue that is often addressed in Bronx County Family Court. If you are involved in a child custody or support case, the court can help you determine the amount of child support that will be paid and ensure that the support payments are made in a timely and consistent manner. The court can also enforce child support orders if necessary.

Bronx Family Court Case Lookup

If you are involved in a case in Bronx County Family Court, you can use the court's online case lookup system to view information about your case, including the date and time of your next court appearance, the status of your case, and any decisions that have been made by the court.

Conclusion

Bronx County Family Court is a critical component of the legal system that provides a forum for resolving disputes and making decisions that will affect families and children. Whether you are going through a divorce, seeking custody of a child, or dealing with a domestic violence case, the court can help you navigate the legal process and make informed decisions. With its wide range of services and resources, Bronx County Family Court is committed to helping families and children through difficult times.
